en.text:
Grants <void/>Volatile Rounds for <pve 9 /> <pvp [3] /> seconds upon exiting <void/>Void Invisibility, making hits with Void Weapons apply <void/>Volatile. 

On Finishers while affected by <void/>Void Invisibility:
• Grants a 35% Weapon Damage Empowering Buff for 6 seconds
• Grants you and allies within 24 meters the Reserve Overshield buff

Reserve Overshield:
• Grants 500% Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate
• Consumed on Class Ability usage, granting the user a 40 HP <void/>Void Overshield for 10 seconds

(Letting the timer run out with Echo of Persistence equipped will not grant you <void/>Volatile Rounds. <void/>Volatile explosions do not count as damage originating from your weapon.)
